graft two trees; combine them and share the root

graft-atctree-atctree-method.Rd

graft two trees; combine them and share the root

Usage

# S4 method for class 'atctree,atctree'
graft(h1, h2, ...)

Arguments

h1

an atctree

h2

an atctree

...

more atctree objects

Value

an object of class atctree

Details

at the moment the branches need to be of the same schema/have the same levels

Examples

# some nodes involving inflammation from look(h, "inflamm")
h <- atctree(schema="full")
h1 <- cutting(h, "M01")
h2 <- cutting(h, "A07")
graft(h1,h2) |> plot(circle=TRUE, leaf=FALSE)
#> Remember you can hover over nodes to see text



h1 <- h["P01",-3] #P01 to great grandchildren
#> Error in .local(x, i, j, ...): object 'h' not found
h2 <- h["C01",-1] #C01 to children
#> Error in .local(x, i, j, ...): object 'h' not found
h3 <- cutting(h, "G01A") #descendents of G01A
graft(h1, h2, h3) |> plot(stem_label=TRUE)
#> Remember you can hover over nodes to see text
